answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The beacon holds work receipts rather than names, so the kernel of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim.
